candidate.question: The Clifford Constitution

options.B: made the Governor dependent on the Executive Council

candidate.explanation: The Clifford Constitution introduced elected representation on a limited franchise, with seats for Lagos and Calabar. This was the elective principle; it did not establish universal adult suffrage.
